title: 套件簽章與供應鏈驗證
summary: 以簽章政策、provenance 與安全更新連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect signature policy, provenance and secure updates through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 內容與信任政策
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「內容與信任政策」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop content and trust policy through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 內容摘要：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「內容摘要」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for content digests.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「內容摘要」的資料、控制與時間關係。摘要識別特定位元而非作者身分。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對來源聲明與摘要差別。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for content digests. Digests identify bytes, not author identity. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare origin claims and digests. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 核對來源聲明與摘要差別。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：透明日誌的存在就代表網站授權該 signer。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: A transparency entry means the site authorized the signer. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「內容摘要」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「摘要識別特定位元而非作者身分。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit content digests two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 內容摘要的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 摘要識別特定位元而非作者身分。
knowledge.textEn: Digests identify bytes, not author identity.

knowledge.title: 內容摘要的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 核對來源聲明與摘要差別。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Compare origin claims and digests. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想更新 metadata 門檻為 2-of-3 金鑰，單一有效簽章不滿足政策；三把中的任兩把才滿足門檻。若 metadata 到期 24 h，即使簽章正確，過期後仍需依政策拒絕，不是永久信任。
knowledge.textEn: For fictional 2-of-3 metadata keys, one valid signature fails policy and any two satisfy the threshold. With 24 h expiry, valid signatures do not establish freshness after expiry.

quiz.question: 本步審查「內容摘要」與整體「套件簽章與供應鏈驗證」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing content digests within package signing and supply-chain verification, which statement or check is supported?
options: 摘要識別特定位元而非作者身分。
透明日誌的存在就代表網站授權該 signer。
有效簽章讓 metadata 永遠不會過期。
optionsEn: Digests identify bytes, not author identity.
A transparency entry means the site authorized the signer.
Valid signatures make metadata never expire.
quiz.explanation: 摘要識別特定位元而非作者身分。 核對來源聲明與摘要差別。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Digests identify bytes, not author identity. Compare origin claims and digests. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 內容摘要：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「核對來源聲明與摘要差別。」檢查「內容摘要」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for content digests using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「內容摘要」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：核對來源聲明與摘要差別。 核對「摘要識別特定位元而非作者身分。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for content digests and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Compare origin claims and digests. Check the principle: Digests identify bytes, not author identity. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 核對來源聲明與摘要差別。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：透明日誌的存在就代表網站授權該 signer。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: A transparency entry means the site authorized the signer. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「內容摘要」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對來源聲明與摘要差別。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit content digests input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.title: Artifact 繫結：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「Artifact 繫結」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for artifact binding.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Artifact 繫結」的資料、控制與時間關係。簽章應繫結完整指定產物。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查 tag 移動後的摘要。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for artifact binding. Signatures bind the exact artifact. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check digest after tag movement. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 檢查 tag 移動後的摘要。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：有效簽章讓 metadata 永遠不會過期。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Valid signatures make metadata never expire. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「Artifact 繫結」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「簽章應繫結完整指定產物。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit artifact binding two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

steps.objective: 用「檢查 tag 移動後的摘要。」檢查「Artifact 繫結」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for artifact binding using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「Artifact 繫結」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：檢查 tag 移動後的摘要。 核對「簽章應繫結完整指定產物。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for artifact binding and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Check digest after tag movement. Check the principle: Signatures bind the exact artifact. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 檢查 tag 移動後的摘要。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：有效簽章讓 metadata 永遠不會過期。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Valid signatures make metadata never expire. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「Artifact 繫結」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「檢查 tag 移動後的摘要。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit artifact binding input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
